messages:
maya: FYI privacy team just opened a time-sensitive subject access / erasure request tied to an active vuln investigation. legal says we might need to hold deletion for forensics, but customer is pushing. Asking: can we do a scoped, auditable limited RBAC grant + KMS access so ops can export artifacts then trigger deletion?
jamal: tagging ops/forensics: what's the minimum key scope for a one-off export without giving blanket decrypt?
eli: short answer: we can create a temporary keystore role that only allows Decrypt on the specific ciphertext prefixes + PutObject into a quarantine bucket. That keeps normal app keys untouched.
robin: can we record everything in audit logs (keystore access + S3 object writes) + immutable evidence snapshot so legal can assert chain of custody?
sophie-legal: yes need chain-of-custody. timeline and who/why. Legal prefers retention exception docs if we pause deletion. Need to know exact TTL change and approver.
security-bot: [ALERT] Incident 2026-3187 opened: vuln-ceres token leak -> potential PII exposure. Watch #incidents for updates.
maya: thanks. Proposal: 1) create role privacy-erasure-delegate@temp (24h) 2) policy: kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-*/enc-* 3) s3:PutObject to s3://privacy-quarantine/2026-3187/ 4) full audit via CloudTrail + export to secure bucket 5) auto-revoke after 24h.
jamal: build the policy snippet, i'll run the grant and monitor. Also: does our keystore rotation or CMK multi-region replication block Decrypt in secondary region? We might need to route to eu-west-1 primary.
eli: policy sketch below — please sanity check.

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-*/enc-*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::privacy-quarantine/2026-3187/*"}
  ]
}
```

robin: add CloudTrail condition so events are logged to the evidence bucket and include aws:RequestTag/erasure-case=2026-3187. Also log to our audit-indexer (elk).
sophie-legal: add retention-exception ticket in legal tracker and note approver = CISO. I need the exact times and users for the record.
maya: timeline: creating role now, will grant to jamal@ops for export. jamal please paste the command when you run it.
jamal: running now, command: `aws iam create-role --role-name privacy-erasure-delegate-temp --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json` then attach policy `aws iam put-role-policy --role-name privacy-erasure-delegate-temp --policy-name erasure-case-2026-3187 --policy-document file://erasure.json`
eli: after export, we must trigger the retention exception workflow if legal says hold. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/security/erasure-playbook (see section "Retention Exceptions and Forensics").
maya: note: avoid deleting any embeddings indices until legal clears — embeddings snapshots can embed PII. If legal permits partial redaction, we need evals team to re-run quality checks.
jamal: export finished; put objects at s3://privacy-quarantine/2026-3187/export-2026-03-21.tar.gz. Copied CloudTrail logs to evidence-bucket. Attaching the audit meta: `exporter=jamal, role=privacy-erasure-delegate-temp, decrypt_key=abcd-12, duration=00:18:34`
security-bot: [AUDIT] role privacy-erasure-delegate-temp assumed by jamal at 4123456805, actions: kms:Decrypt (2), s3:PutObject (6). Logs forwarded to evidence-bucket.

sophie-legal: received artifact link, filing retention-exception. Approver: @ciso (awaiting sign-off). If denied, we'll proceed with deletion per DSAR timeline and capture the decision in the ticket.
robin: after legal sign-off, plan for deletion should include: 1) revoke role 2) run irreversible erase job with keystore tombstone 3) delete S3 quarantine after 90d forensically-flagged retention if approved 4) generate final audit manifest.
eli: small ops note: be careful with KMS grants — do not create a key policy that broadly allows IAM:* as a result of attaching the inline policy. Test in staging first.
maya: thanks team. I'll update the incident and privacy tracker with timestamps and attach this thread. We'll keep the temp role and evidence isolated. :white_check_mark:
